summary.en: The Detective Boys, including Conan and Haibara, accompanied by their teacher Miss Kobayashi, visit the Rampo residence managed by Professor Goto. The storehouse which Rampo used as a library entailed a great deal of valuable books, stimulating the excitement of Conan and the rest. In the meantime, Detective Sato and Detective Takagi arrive, whereupon they are informed that a murder case has taken place in a nearby park. And - what is more - the victim's belongings seem to be related to the storehouse that was often closed to the public... Camera footage from a convenience store near the scene of the murder caught the appearance of Goto, who went there following a call offering to show him Ranpo's unpublished manuscript, so he became a suspect of the murder. Suddenly, Genta’s stomach growls, so Professor Goto’s assistant Ryosuke Okumoto suggests they have lunch at the cafeteria as it is almost time to close the storehouse. At the cafeteria, we can see Okumoto is having a conversation with the other members of the Ranpo Association, with Kobayashi’s group soon joining as they are curious about the Association, but the conversation goes awkward when Oguruma mentions about what happened to Katsumine. Later, one by one, Okumoto's group begins to split up to do their own thing, with Rikkyo University guide Mizumori offering to take Kobayashi's group on a tour that afternoon.
